original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. armada-nitro's lib/armada-poc submodule points at armada-poc integrated (5d076c4eb9f27dd931d6c0b392b92cd850cb66d5), which carries the M8 privacy pool and its Snark Groth16 library at contracts/privacy-pool/types/SnarkTypes.sol. forge build, forge test and the pre-commit gate all pass with that pin.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. lib/armada-poc points at 2db1d33, the tip of fork/arn-e7a-client-rpc. That branch forked from armada-poc main before the M8 pool work. At 2db1d33, contracts/privacy-pool/types/SnarkTypes.sol and PoolTypes.sol do not exist. The only verifier there is VerifierModule.verify(Transaction), which is onlyDelegatecall and pool-storage-bound. A channel app cannot reuse a standalone Groth16 checker.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run git ls-tree HEAD lib/armada-poc: the gitlink equals 5d076c4eb9f27dd931d6c0b392b92cd850cb66d5, not 2db1d33. Run git -C lib/armada-poc cat-file -e HEAD:contracts/privacy-pool/types/SnarkTypes.sol: it exits 0. Run forge build: it exits 0. Run forge test: the summary reports 0 failed. Run pre-commit run --all-files: the forge-test hook prints Passed.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. Do not change src/nitro (vendored go-nitro, excluded from every hook). Edit the armada-nitro files that import the pool only as far as the pin bump needs: test/helpers/ArmadaFixture.sol, test/helpers/ArmadaNotes.sol, test/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.t.sol, and the scripts under script/. Preserve the behavior the existing e2e jobs check. Do not add a second Groth16 verifier; reuse the M8 pool Snark library.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) armada-nitro lib/armada-poc submodule pin, and the files that import armada/privacy-pool and armada/cctp.
restatement: The armada-nitro repository must pin its lib/armada-poc submodule to armada-poc integrated commit 5d076c4eb9f27dd931d6c0b392b92cd850cb66d5, not 2db1d33. That commit carries the M8 privacy pool and its Snark Groth16 library at contracts/privacy-pool/types/SnarkTypes.sol, so a channel app can reuse a standalone Groth16 checker. After the bump, forge build, forge test and the pre-commit gate must all pass. Only the files that import the pool may change, and only as far as the bump needs. These are test/helpers/ArmadaFixture.sol, test/helpers/ArmadaNotes.sol, test/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.t.sol and the scripts under script/. The vendored src/nitro stays untouched. No second Groth16 verifier is added.

pre-commit run --all-files passes, and the forge-test hook prints Passed.
No second Groth16 verifier is added. The M8 pool Snark library is reused.
